name: orbit-dashboards-root
description: Orbit Dashboards root proxy forwarding all commands to Building-cosmic

scripts.start:cosmic: node init && npm --prefix Building-cosmic run start:cosmic
scripts.start:comic: node init && npm --prefix Building-cosmic run start:comic
scripts.dev: node init && npm --prefix Building-cosmic run dev
scripts.dev:cosmic: node init && npm --prefix Building-cosmic run dev:cosmic
scripts.dev:comic: node init && npm --prefix Building-cosmic run dev:comic
scripts.build: node init && npm --prefix Building-cosmic run build
scripts.build:unpack: node init && npm --prefix Building-cosmic run build:unpack
